intro.text: A busy intersection in Luthadel, named for the four wells at its corners.

description.text: Each corner has a well, and at the centre stands a copper fountain showing the Lord Ruler with the defeated Deepness at his feet.
So many people pass through that beggars prize a spot here and have to fight to keep it.

items.text: When Kelsier had Camon made a beggar, Camon failed to win a place at the crossroads and had to beg in a smaller, quieter square three streets to the west.
